posts.text:
There are everyday heroes.

Humble.
Steady.
Relentless in their kindness.

Every day, amidst it all, they stand up for others.

They give more than is expected.
Help more than is required.
Offer more grace than most people will see.

May we walk through the world this way.

May we remind one another that, despite the trials, the tribulations, and the bad actors, goodness still abounds.

May we see it.
May we celebrate it.
May we be it.

You belong.

Your voice matters.

Your presence has purpose.

Your contributions make a difference.

There will always be people who try to diminish you.

Don’t let them.

No one can make you feel unworthy without your permission.

The world gives us countless reasons to be discouraged.

Let’s give one another more reasons for defiant joy.
More reasons for relentless kindness.

May we see it.
May we be it.

op: @abcnews4

There are good people all across our nation.

Despite a media ecosystem and social media algorithms that so often amplify hate, outrage, division, and cruelty, there are countless acts of kindness happening every single day.

Be the reason someone believes in the goodness of people.

Lift up the quiet acts of compassion, the daring deeds of generosity, and the humble heroism of ordinary people helping one another.

And above all, be kind.

op: @sparksdafello

It doesn't take much to share kindness, to express gratitude, to make a difference to someone and remind them that there is so much decency in this world.

op: @reporterkait

Kindness begets kindness 
Heroism inspires heroes 
Generosity multiplies again and again.
